import kit, encode

       {"name":"St2","kind":"enum","values":["A","B"]}]
mods=[{"name":"m1","params":[["st","St1"],["msg","Msg"]],"result":["r","Bool"],"requires":None},
      {"name":"m2","params":[["st","St2"],["msg","Msg"]],"result":["r","Bool"],"requires":None}]

            "entries":entries,"machine":machine,"runs":[]}

# two states, no transitions -> B unreachable
